daily.title: Fiona O'Byrne wins 2026 Lester Prize with painting of daughter
daily.summary: The Melbourne-based artist, who has been painting her children for more than a decade, has won $50,000 for the artwork.

daily.title: Two stolen Renoir paintings found, six people arrested

daily.title: Couple jailed for torturing 14-week-old puppy to death

daily.title: Anthony De Ceglie steps down as Perth Bears CEO

daily.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Judge Navi Pillay

daily.title: Person of interest given alibi in schoolgirl's disappearance

daily.title: More than 65,000 Canberrans are waiting to see a medical specialist

daily.title: NT government flags changes to accused sex offender suppression laws

daily.title: Sale rescues landmark WA dairy brands from collapse

daily.title: Australia and New Zealand police target motorbike gang deemed 'high threat'
